blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has directed continuous wildlife monitoring along the Cacaransan-Saputan Road in Calbayog City following a series of Philippine tarsier deaths. “Immediately following the reports, DENR personnel from the Calbayog Pan-as-Hayiban Protected Landscape conducted an on-site investigation, verified the reported locations, gathered information from witnesses and local stakeholders, coordinated with barangay officials, and documented the circumstances surrounding the incidents,” it said. Panay News, a regional publication, earlier reported that another dead tarsier was found along the road in Calbayog City, Samar, on Oct. 22. It was the fourth recorded death in the […]...
